text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon triumphs in 1st place at the 
Yasuda Kinen. The spectators eagerly look 
forward to her future feats and her 
showdown with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon wanted to compete on a big 
stage once more before the Arima Kinen. 
She decided to enter the Japan Cup.
